title: You Have 5 Seconds!
reviewNotes: Three separate supported seven-piece diagrams after axb6 (46s), bxa6 (60s) and White axb7 in the Rf7 variation (67s). Main line promotes with check and captures b7; the pawn-capture diagram is actual Rb8 mate; in the Rf7 branch axb6 leaves b8=Q winning. Earlier eight-piece Rg6/Rb6 remain context and no complete tree connecting nodes is asserted. Caption’s final winning-for-Black phrase corrected by exact White-winning evidence; blitz timing guarantee excluded.
transcript: You're playing a blitz game and you have 5 seconds to find a solution. Can you win this game? Hopefully, you were able to find the move rook to G6. Every other move draws the game. Now, the point is that after the king moves to F8, we can actually play rook G7 and we are cutting the communication of this black rook with the pawns on the other side. And if the rook takes, we're going to take back with check, take the pawn, and promote. But what happens if the king goes to H8? This is where the real challenge was. And probably only geniuses were able to solve this. The one and only move that wins for white is rook to B6. A beautiful move. The idea is, of course, that if the rook is taken now, we have created a path for the pawn. And since the black king is preventing the rook to go to the corner, we're simply going to promote, get a queen, and win the game like this. And hopefully you were able to see that after this pawn takes, we have a checkmate like this. And finally, I imagine you were able to see that if the rook goes to F7, we simply take the pawn, the rook cannot sacrifice itself because that's winning for white. So the pawn will have to take. And now we can finally promote. And this is still winning for black. It's a simple matter of premoving the queen versus rook endgame and you're going to secure the win. Guys, before you go to the next video, I need to remind you that there's only a few days left to join the Caraval Cup in Rome. And with this code, you can get a €35 discount on the entry fee. Don't miss out on this beautiful opportunity.
